title: Fred Reed's letter on relandscaping the mesa
summary: Scott Ramsay tells of Fred Reed's letter on relandscaping the mesa, about 1948; letter 1999 at New Mexico (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: They came basically to rellandscape the the uh mesa.

plain: A researcher named Scott Ramsay, who studies a reported 1948 UFO crash at Hart Canyon near Aztec, New Mexico, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about a letter from a man named Fred Reed, dated March 27, 1999. According to Ramsay, Reed's letter says people came to the site to relandscape the mesa, the flat-topped hill where the crash is said to have happened. If true, it would mean someone reshaped the land to hide traces of a crash.
